latest_material_cycle.trigger: Ali found that technically cautious Episode 01 definitions still fell below the LAiDIES writing and explanation standard and requested correction wherever the same concepts appear.
latest_material_cycle.status: VERIFIED LOCALLY — REPRESENTATIVE TRUTH + TEACHING-COPY CORRECTION
latest_material_cycle.action: Separated definition, mechanism, reader consequence, bounded analogy and memory line; propagated the correction through representative episode, Study Pack, Library, quiz and class sources; prepared exact Episode 01 and Basics Class 01 narration replacements; visually checked every populated card back; replaced the semantically false Model front with artwork that shows a model as one component in a larger system.
observed_results: The strongest reusable class source is basics-what-these-tools-are.CONTENT.md because it separates product, model, context, tools and account entitlement.
The former basics-how-it-works.CONTENT.md collapsed a language-model training mechanism into a complete product explanation and overpromised self-checking; it was replaced.
The older 25% and 78:100 participation treatments were superseded by the May 2026 HBS Working Paper version.
The Stanford 22%-94% sycophancy range was incorrectly presented as a general hallucination rate in Concepts 101 and was removed.
New narration is required before the released Episode 01 audio/video or Basics Class 01 can carry the correction.
All four populated Trading Card backs passed local desktop visual safe-area review; maintained learning links now sit below the flipped card instead of being squeezed into the artwork.
Source-register language is not publishable teaching copy: the source owns the truth boundary while each surface must perform its distinct learning job in LAiDIES language.

The rejected Model front used fake publications/provider marks and therefore taught brand or product equals model. Its replacement shows a removable model component inside a larger system, with files, search and memory kept visually separate; collection-size browser QA passed without console warnings or errors.
latest_material_cycle.acceptance: LOCAL SOURCE AND CARD VISUAL CORRECTION VERIFIED; INDEPENDENT LEARNER/EDITORIAL ADMISSION, NEW NARRATION, INTEGRATION AND PUBLIC VERIFICATION REMAIN OPEN
